nodes.text:
Its 3x3 input and 3x3 output buffers compact matching material stacks into denser forms. The configuration covers vanilla materials, every compressed-block tier, and the item containers shipped by this pack. It accepts Speed, Energy, Hyper Processing, and Stack upgrades. Costs start at 800 DE for nugget-to-ingot and multiply by nine for each successive compression level.

Item I/O:
§9Input§r exposes all nine material slots.
§cOutput§r exposes all nine compressed-result slots.
